findings.detail: X07 is firing on debt/revolver rows whose source amortized-cost and fair-value cells are correctly extracted, including negative-cost commitment rows and one low-cost delayed draw term loan.

rationale: Raw SOI rows confirm the challenged amortized-cost and fair-value values: negative-cost revolver/DDTL rows such as Charlie RF Voltron and Velocity Buyer are filed that way, and Allergy & Clinical MidCo is filed with amortized cost 10 and fair value 124. The flag is caused by X07 treating these source-correct small or negative cost bases as data errors, not by an extraction or normalization defect.
